## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive; confirmation: broad sector breadth and cyclicals/financials leading (Industrials, Energy, Financials). Note major divergence: multiple large names showing 1W up / 1M down (RECOVERY) — temper strong conviction.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Industrials lead: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND — Industrials: 11/15 positive. Energy strong: OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND — Energy: 8/10 positive. Financials solid: JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND — Financials: 14/20 positive. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: Value/Cyclical.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Materials weak: NUE (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%) BELOW TREND — Materials: 4/11 positive. Consumer Staples weak: WMT (1W: -7.97% | 1M: +3.04%) CORRECTION — Consumer Staples: 5/14 positive. Technology mixed: MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -10.35%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND — Technology: 15/24 positive.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership concentrated across Tech/Energy/Industrials.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: ETN (1W: -4.34% | 1M: +10.48%) CORRECTION, INTU (1W: -4.37% | 1M: -27.50%) BELOW TREND, NUE (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%) BELOW TREND, MDLZ (1W: -4.95% | 1M: +2.53%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in select Tech and Materials names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W movers: AMAT (1W: +14.45%), SHOP (1W: +14.04%), OXY (1W: +13.96%), DE (1W: +10.76%), GE (1W: +9.69%). Watch RECOVERY names (SHOP, PYPL (1W: +6.58% | 1M: -25.48%) RECOVERY, AMZN (1W: +5.27% | 1M: -9.17%) RECOVERY) — this is a MAJOR divergence signal that warrants tactical caution.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed but constructive beneath the surface: AAPL (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +7.24%) ABOVE TREND, while MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -10.35%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND drag; Technology breadth: 15/24 positive.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials showing leadership breadth with bank strength and idiosyncratic payments pain: JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +6.58% | 1M: -25.48%) RECOVERY, V (1W: -1.00% | 1M: -1.13%) BELOW TREND; Financials breadth: 14/20 positive.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Patchy: JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -16.61%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND — Healthcare breadth: 9/17 positive; monitor headline-driven moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor cyclicals/value exposure given RISK-ON: prefer DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to select Tech laggards such as INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND. Maintain size discipline — many RECOVERY names look tactical, not structural.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -10.35%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Industrials (11/15 positive) and Energy (8/10 positive) — watch earnings/guidance follow-through. BEARISH: Materials (4/11 positive) and Consumer Staples (5/14 positive) where internals are weak.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch NVDA (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND for a clean weekly close above the recent 1M high for momentum confirmation; AAPL (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND — hold of the 1M support zone to validate the uptrend; JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND — sustained weekly gains would confirm Financials leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
DE (+80): upbeat earnings/guidance; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) — sentiment confirmed. OXY (+55): dividend hike headline; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) — confirmed accumulation. JNJ (+60): FDA breakthrough status; price CORRECTION (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) — bullish news vs short-term weakness (divergence).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
INTC (-50): downgrade/weakness; price BELOW TREND (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) — sentiment confirmed. V (-50): antitrust setback; price BELOW TREND (1W: -1.00% | 1M: -1.13%) — headline risk to watch. EL (-50): analyst downgrade; price RECOVERY (1W: +7.34% | 1M: -3.09%) — bearish headlines vs short-term bounce (divergence).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style.  
Industrials and Energy are showing clear strength — DE (ABOVE TREND), OXY (ABOVE TREND), AMAT (ABOVE TREND) among leaders.  
Key risk: major divergence across large names (multiple RECOVERY cases) and headline-driven moves in Tech/Payments — monitor sentiment-confirmation for follow-through.
